title: Netguru's Next in Commerce: Eric Ries with Kuba Filipowski (May 28)
summary: Netguru is a Polish design and engineering firm whose podcast Next in Commerce, formerly Disruption Talks, has run past 190 episodes. It booked Eric for a live conversation with its co-founder and chief executive in the week Incorruptible came out.
blockquote:
So, this is BIG: Eric Ries comes to our Next in Commerce Podcast 🔥🔥🔥 The one and only bestselling author and visionary founder will join a conversation with Kuba Filipowski, Netguru's Co-Founder & CEO. … 

Join us on Thursday, May 28, at 3 PM CEST to hear about:

-Eric's brand new book, "Incorruptible", that launches May 26
-the Lean Startup principles in the AI Era
-the vibe-coding trap and how real-world feedback is the antidote
-how mission-driven companies can thrive in a profit-oriented world
